scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run copy:assets && npm run copy:playable && npm run copy:playable-runtime
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.copy:assets: shx mkdir -p dist/src/backends/html/assets && shx cp -r src/backends/html/assets/* dist/src/backends/html/assets/
scripts.copy:playable-runtime: shx mkdir -p dist/src/backends/playable/html/assets/runtime && shx cp -r src/runtime dist/src/backends/playable/html/assets/
scripts.generate:ascii:all: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){ execSync('node ./dist/src/cli/main.js auto --variant '+i+' --backend ascii', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.generate:html:all: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){ execSync('node ./dist/src/cli/main.js auto --variant '+i+' --backend html', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.generate:json:all: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){ execSync('node ./dist/src/cli/main.js auto --variant '+i+' --backend json', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.generate:playable:html:all: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){ execSync('node ./dist/src/cli/main.js generate examples/variant-'+i+'/program.fl examples/variant-'+i+' --target playable --playable-backend html', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.test:name: vitest run --testNamePattern
